plugins.name: claude-codemap
plugins.description: Generates and maintains a codemap in .claude/codemap/ for fast file lookup and symbol navigation, reducing token usage and speeding up navigation

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Custom status line: model/effort, context usage, cache hit rate, rate limits, session/daily/monthly cost, git branch, and cwd

plugins.name: model-manager
plugins.description: Per-task model and effort policy for subagents, named-agent routing, dispatch enforcement and cost report by model

plugins.name: tech-lead
plugins.description: Lead orchestrator: plans a spec into waves of tasks, assigns the cheapest capable model to each, delegates, reviews and verifies; adds hygiene passes, expert panels and UI/UX review; keeps project docs, status and backlog in one hierarchy; periodic status reports with questions for the owner asked as choices without stopping work; optional superdesign mockup provider

plugins.name: status-report
plugins.description: Periodic and per-release owner status report in five sections (released, in progress with %, next, milestones with %, questions waiting on the owner), built from git tags and GitHub issue checklists
